articles.title: Grinning Chuck Grassley unwittingly shares crude photobomb moment: 'Hide your sheep!'
articles.description: Sen. Chuck Grassley unwittingly sent a crude message to his constituents Saturday when a social media post went awry. Grassley (R-IA) smiled for the camera as he posed next to a sheep at the Iowa State Fair — apparently unaware of the photobomb behind him "My compliments to the sheep barn at the Iowa state fair for having warm water when u wash ur hands," wrote Grassley. "Pretty nice." Behind him, a young man's t-shirt delivered a contrasting message: "I [heart] sluts." If Grassley didn't notice the youth, his X followers sure did. "Maybe check your surrounding before taking the picture," replied one X user. "Is this your nephew waiting on your photo op?" asked another . "'I love sluts' shirt in the back left is too much!" an apparent fan replied. "It’s still early, said another fan , "but Grassley may have won the internet for the day." Gene Szpiech had a warning: "Hide your sheep!" This isn't the first time this month Grassley's public outreach has left people scratching their heads. Just last Saturday, he penned a loving eulogy to his vacuum cleaner Beth.

articles.title: Political rivals should not let differences turn into animosity, says Nawaz
articles.description: PML-N supremo Nawaz Sharif said on Saturday that while political differences between opponents were common during elections, they should never turn into animosity, apparently referring to the deepening differences between the ruling party and its coalition partner, the PPP, at the Centre. Elections are being held across AJK in three division-wise phases amid tensions between protesters and the authorities that have been ongoing for over two months. Addressing a party convention in Murree, the party president congratulated the winners of the elections in Azad Jammu and Kashmir, while extending commiserations to the losing candidates. However, he noted that the complaints from the PPP have been “upsetting”. “We have always maintained good relations with our opponents. There is always disagreement in politics, but it should not reach the point where it creates animosity,” he said. “This is unacceptable.” The PML-N supremo noted that AJK’s atmosphere has always been good, but lamented seeing the buildup of enmity. “I was upset over their losses, and I have good relations with them personally,” Nawaz said. “We need to look at those factors which contributed to their defeat. We had very good candidates who bravely contested these elections. If they were defeated, we must look at the reasons why.” He noted, “We can lose seats, but we cannot lose our spirit.” More to follow
